title: Farness of functions
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\beta$ be a set with decidable equality, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\beta$. They are far at tolerance $\varepsilon\in\mathbb{R}$ when $\varepsilon$ is strictly less than their relative Hamming distance.
